faq.q: Is checking a zip someone sent me limited on the free tier?
faq.a: No. Listing, unpacking and reading entries are never metered. The free limits apply only to zips you create.

faq.q: Does it upload my files?
faq.a: Not on the local install. It makes no network call of any kind, and everything happens on your machine. The hosted URL takes the zip in the request and keeps it on the server for a limited time.

faq.q: Can it open password-protected zips?
faq.a: No. Encrypted entries are flagged and refused.
